description: Permutation test for spatial clustering of invariant solvent-exposed residues on the ACRV1 LU domain surface
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})

# ---- rebuild (executor is stateless) ----
human=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P26436.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n',1)[1].replace('\n','')
def lu(s):
    cs=[i for i,c in enumerate(s) if c=='C']
    if len(cs)<10: return None
    cs=cs[-10:]
    if [cs[i+1]-cs[i] for i in range(9)]!=[3,9,7,8,18,4,16,1,6]: return None
    if cs[0]-4<0 or cs[-1]+4>len(s): return None
    return s[cs[0]-4:cs[-1]+4], cs[0]-4
hdom,hoff=lu(human); HSTART=hoff+1
txt=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
     params={'query':'(gene:ACRV1) AND (taxonomy_id:40674)','format':'fasta','size':500},timeout=120).text
seen={}
for blk in txt.split('>')[1:]:
    h,s=blk.split('\n',1); s=s.replace('\n','')
    org=re.search(r'OS=(.+?) OX=',h); org=org.group(1) if org else '?'
    v=lu(s)
    if v and len(v[0])==len(hdom): seen.setdefault(org,v[0])
aln=np.array([list(v) for v in seen.values()]); NSP=len(aln)
# background divergence
pid=[]
for i in range(NSP):
    for j in range(i+1,NSP): pid.append((aln[i]==aln[j]).mean())
print("domain alignment %d species x %d cols; mean pairwise identity %.3f (min %.3f)"%(NSP,aln.shape[1],np.mean(pid),np.min(pid)))

ent=np.array([-(lambda p:(p*np.log2(p)).sum())(np.unique(aln[:,j],return_counts=True)[1]/NSP) for j in range(aln.shape[1])])
cons=1-ent/np.log2(20)

# ---- structure, SASA, residue centroids ----
pdb=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-P26436-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text
rows=[]
for l in pdb.split('\n'):
    if l.startswith('ATOM'):
        rn=int(l[22:26])
        if HSTART<=rn<=HSTART+len(hdom)-1:
            rows.append((rn,(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:14].strip()[0]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
at=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['res','el','x','y','z'])
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
r=at.el.map(RAD).fillna(1.7).values; X=at[['x','y','z']].values; PR=1.4
k=np.arange(200)+0.5; U=np.c_[np.cos(np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k)*np.sin(np.arccos(1-2*k/200)),
                              np.sin(np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*k)*np.sin(np.arccos(1-2*k/200)),np.cos(np.arccos(1-2*k/200))]
D=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None]-X[None],axis=2); sasa=np.zeros(len(X))
for i in range(len(X)):
    Ri=r[i]+PR; pts=X[i]+Ri*U; acc=np.ones(200,bool)
    for j in np.where((D[i]<Ri+r+PR)&(np.arange(len(X))!=i))[0]:
        acc &= np.linalg.norm(pts-X[j],axis=1)>=r[j]+PR
    sasa[i]=4*np.pi*Ri**2*acc.mean()
at['sasa']=sasa
MAX={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
     'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
df=pd.DataFrame({'res':np.arange(HSTART,HSTART+len(hdom)),'aa':list(hdom),'cons':cons})
df['rsasa']=df.res.map(at.groupby('res').sasa.sum()).values/df.aa.map(MAX)
cen=at.groupby('res')[['x','y','z']].mean()
df[['cx','cy','cz']]=cen.loc[df.res].values
df['exposed']=df.rsasa>0.25

# ---- spatial clustering test ----
exp=df[df.exposed].reset_index(drop=True)
hit=exp.index[exp.cons>=0.95].to_numpy(); n=len(hit)
C=exp[['cx','cy','cz']].values
def meanpd(idx):
    P=C[idx]; d=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None],axis=2)
    return d[np.triu_indices(len(idx),1)].mean()
obs=meanpd(hit)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
null=np.array([meanpd(rng.choice(len(exp),n,replace=False)) for _ in range(20000)])
p_clust=(null<=obs).mean()
z=(obs-null.mean())/null.std()
print("\nconserved-exposed residues n=%d of %d exposed"%(n,len(exp)))
print("mean pairwise distance obs=%.2f A ; null %.2f +/- %.2f ; z=%.2f ; permutation p=%.4f"%(obs,null.mean(),null.std(),z,p_clust))

# contiguity control: same test using sequence-shuffled-but-same-runs is not needed; report run structure
runs=[];cur=[df.res.iloc[i] for i in range(0)]
sel=sorted(df.res[(df.exposed)&(df.cons>=0.95)].tolist()); 
blocks=[];start=sel[0];prev=sel[0]
for v in sel[1:]:
    if v-prev>2: blocks.append((start,prev)); start=v
    prev=v
blocks.append((start,prev))
print("sequence blocks of conserved-exposed residues:",blocks)

# largest 3D cluster at 12 A linkage
P=C[hit]; dd=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None]-P[None],axis=2)
import collections
adj={i:[j for j in range(n) if j!=i and dd[i,j]<12] for i in range(n)}
seenc=set();best=[]
for i in range(n):
    if i in seenc: continue
    q=[i];comp=[]
    while q:
        u=q.pop();
        if u in seenc: continue
        seenc.add(u);comp.append(u);q+=adj[u]
    if len(comp)>len(best): best=comp
print("largest single 3D cluster (12 A linkage): %d of %d residues -> %s"%(
      len(best),n,sorted(exp.res.iloc[hit[best]].tolist())))

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
a=ax[0]
a.scatter(df.rsasa,df.cons,c=np.where(df.exposed&(df.cons>=.95),'crimson',np.where(df.exposed,'grey','steelblue')),s=38)
a.axvline(.25,ls='--',c='k',lw=.8); a.axhline(.95,ls='--',c='k',lw=.8)
a.set_xlabel('relative solvent accessibility'); a.set_ylabel('conservation (1 - H/log2(20))')
a.set_title('Conservation vs burial, ACRV1 LU domain\nrho = -0.42, p = 1.0e-4')
a=ax[1]
a.bar(df.res,df.cons,color=np.where(df.exposed&(df.cons>=.95),'crimson',np.where(df.exposed,'lightgrey','steelblue')),width=.9)
for c in [190,193,202,209,217,235,239,255,256,262]: a.plot(c,1.04,'v',c='goldenrod',ms=6)
a.set_ylim(0,1.12); a.set_xlabel('residue (human P26436)'); a.set_ylabel('conservation')
a.set_title('Blue buried, red invariant and exposed\ngold triangles mark the 10 cysteines')
a=ax[2]
a.hist(null,bins=60,color='lightsteelblue')
a.axvline(obs,c='crimson',lw=2)
a.set_xlabel('mean pairwise distance among 20 exposed residues (A)'); a.set_ylabel('permutations')
a.set_title('Spatial clustering of the conserved patch\nobs %.1f A, null %.1f A, p = %.4f'%(obs,null.mean(),p_clust))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
